title: Little Girl Sharon in Plaid Dress Shielding Eyes, 1949 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A sunny post-war candid snapshot from August 1949 capturing a young girl identified on the back as Sharon standing on a concrete path outdoors. She squintingly shields her eyes or smooths her tousled hair against the bright sunlight. She wears a quintessential mid-century child's outfit consisting of a plaid suspender jumper over a white collared blouse, along with folded white ankle socks and dark buckled shoes. To the right, a lightweight folding stroller or pusher cart frame is parked. In the background across a manicured lawn stands a substantial neoclassical stone building with window awnings, evoking mid-20th-century American family leisure and post-WWII civic landscapes.
